answer: Require every agent to build a public, signed work history before it can earn: new identities start in the tundra of zero trust, and each completed job adds a verifiable receipt from a paying counterparty. Like a tide, trust rises only with consistent, checkable work and drains away after inactivity or a failed job, so a fresh fake identity is an empty oasis with nothing to sell. Forging one receipt costs a real completed job, so spinning up a thousand Sybils costs a thousand jobs' worth of effort, while honest agents keep their earned standing.
